### 📌 **When Will the Moon Be Visible?**

The Moon will be **visible** when it is **above the horizon**, which is typically **after sunset**. Since you're in Perth, the **moonrise** will occur shortly after **10:00 PM AWST** on the same day, and the Moon will be visible in the **eastern sky**.

---

### 📌 **Tips for Future Observations:**

- Look for the **Moon when it is above the horizon** (i.e., after sunset).

---
